remarks: Private Country Living with Exceptional Space, Views & Versatility. Tucked away 800 feet from the road and surrounded by 15 scenic acres, this impressive 2021-built farmhouse offers the privacy, and peaceful setting that is increasingly hard to find. Inside, the home offers an abundance of open living space with a layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen and dining area serve as the centerpiece of the first floor, along with a large walk-in pantry. A full bathroom and first-floor bedroom provide flexibility for guests, extended family, or those looking for convenient single-level living. Two main floor covered porches extend the living space outdoors and provide places to enjoy morning coffee, or the quiet views across the property. Upstairs, four additional areas of living space include three large bedrooms, a full bathroom, an office space, bonus room, and additional storage. The second-floor balcony offers another are to enjoy the country air. The full basement provides substantial space and includes a second kitchen area along with a roughed-in bathroom, having potential for additional living, recreation, workshop, or storage space. Outside, the property is exceptionally well suited for the hobby farmer, equestrian enthusiast, homesteader, or anyone who simply needs room A substantial 60' x 36' barn features 15 tie stalls and generous hay storage above, while an additional 16' x 56' outbuilding provides even more room for storage, equipment, or hobbies. The property is currently being subdivided from a larger parcel, with additional acreage potentially available for a buyer seeking more land and privacy. The home is wired but is not currently electrified and is heated by a wood furnace, offering an opportunity for the next owner to complete the property according to their own needs and preferences. Whether envisioned as a private country homestead, hobby farm, equestrian property, this property offers a wonderful combination of modern construction, open living space, impressive outbuildings, scenic views, and genuine privacy. GMO’s and Timber Convey. 3.1 miles to Peak & Peek, 3.3 miles to Clymer, 1.5 miles to French Creek.
